eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Die Senustelsel handhaaf hemeostase deur senu impulse deur die lyf te stuur om bloedvloei aan die gang en onversteurd te hou.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Hierdie senuwee impulse kan so vinnig regdeur die liggaam gestuur word en dit veilig help hou van enige potensiële bedreiging.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornadoes tref klein areas in vergelyking met ander geweldadige storms, maar hul kan alles in hul pad vernietig.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tornados ontwortel bome, ruk borde van geboue, en gooi karre op in die lug in. Die mees gewelddadige twee persent tornadoes duur meer as drie ure.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Sulke monster storms het winde van tot 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Mense maak en gebruik al vir duisende en duisende jare lense vir vergroting.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Die eerste ware teleskope is egter in Europa in die laat 16de eeu gemaak.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Daardie teleskope het ‘n kombinasie van twee lense gebruik om ver voorwerpe beide nader en groter te laat voorkom.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Gierigheid en selfsug sal altyd met ons wees en dit is die aard van samewerking dat wanneer die meerderheid voordeel trek sal daar altyd meer gewin wees daarin om op die kort termyn selfsugtig op te tree.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Hopelik, sal meeste mense besef dat die beste langtermyn opsie is om saam met ander te werk.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Vele mense droom van die dag wanneer die mensdom na ‘n ander ster kan reis en ander wêrelde kan verken. Sommige mense wonder wat is daar buite en sommiges glo dat daar ruimte vreemdeling of ander lewe is op ‘n ander planeet.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Maar, as hierdie ooit gebeur, moontlik sal dit nie vir ‘n baie lang tyd gebeur nie. Die sterre is so uitgespry dat daar triljoene myle tussen sterre is wat “bure” is.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Dalk sal jou agter kleinkinders eendag op ‘n uitheemse wêreld staan en wonder oor hul antieke voorouers?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Diere is gemaak van baie selle. Hulle eet goed en verteer dit aan die binnekant. Meeste diere kan beweeg.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Slegs diere het 'n brein (maar nie alle diere het nie; jellievisse het byvoorbeeld nie ‘n brein nie).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Diere word regoor die aarde gevind. Hulle grawe in die grond, swem n die seë, en vlieg in die lug.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: ‘n Sel is die kleinste strukturele en funksionele eenheid van ‘n lewende (dinge) organisme.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sel kom vanaf die Latynse word cella wat klein kamertjie beteken.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Indien jy na lewende dinge kyk onder 'n mikroskoop, sal jy sien dat hulle uit klein vierkante of balletjies bestaan.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, ‘n bioloog van Engeland, het met ‘n mikroskoop klein vierkantjies in kurk gesien.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Dit lyk soos kamers. Hy was die eerste person wat die dooie selle gesien het.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Elemente en samestellings kan van een toestand na ‘n ander oorgaan en nie verander nie.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Stikstof as ‘n gas het dieselfde eienskappe as vloeibare stikstof. Die vloeistof staat is digter, maar die molekules is steeds dieselfde.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Water is ‘n ander voorbeeld. Die saamgestelde water is opgemaak uit twee hydrogen atome en een suurstof atom.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Dit het dieselfde molekulêre struktuur of dit nou ‘n gas, vloeistof of vastestof is.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Al verander die fisiese toestand bly die chemiese toestand dieselfde.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Tyd is iets wat reg rondom ons is, en alles wat ons doen beïnvloed, al is dit moeilik om te verstaan.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Tyd word al duisende jare bestudeer deur godsdienstige, filosofiese en wetenskaplike kenners.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Ons ervaar tyd as ‘n reeks van gebeurtenisse wat vanaf die toekoms deur die huidige na die verlede deurgaan.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Tyd is hoe ons die duur (lengte) van gebeure vergelyk.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Jy kan die verloop van tyd self merk deur die repetisie van 'n sikliese gebeurtenis te aanskou. 'n Sikliese gebeurtenis is iets wat gereeld oor en oor gebeur.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Rekenaars vandag word gebruik om fotos en videos te manipuleer.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Gesofistikeerde diere kan gekonstrueer word op rekenaars, en hierdie tipe animasie word toenemend in televisie en films gebruik.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Musiek word meestal opgeneem deur die gebruik van gesofistikeerde rekenaars om die klanke te prosesseer en saam te meng.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Vir ‘n lang tyd gedurende die negentiende en die twintigste eeue is daar geglo dat die eerste bewoners van Nieeu-Seeland die Maori mense was, wat groot voëls genaamd moas, gejag het.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Die teorie het die idee bevestig dat die Maori mense migreer het van Polenisië in ‘n Groot Vloot en het New Zeeland gevat van die Moriori, en daardeur ‘n landbou gemeenskap gestig het.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Nuwe bewyse suggereer egter dat die Moriori ‘n groep van die hoofland Maori was wat migreer het van New Zeeland na die Chatham Eilande, waar hul hul eie kenmerkende,vredeliewende kultuur ontwikkel het.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Daar was ook 'n ander Maori-stam op die Chatham eilande wat migreer het van Nieu-Seeland af.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Hulle het hulleself die Moriori genoem, daar was ‘n paar skermutselinge, en die Moriori is uitgewis aan die einde.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Individue wat betrokke was vir verskeie dekades het ons gehelp om ons sterkpunte en passies te waardeer terwyl ons probleme en mislukkings assesseer.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Terwyl ons geluister het na individue wat hul individuele, familie, en organisatoriese stories vertel het, het ons waardevolle insigte in die verlede bekom en sommige van die persoonlikhede wat die kultuur van die organisasie ten goede of kwade beïnvloed het.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Terwyl 'n mens se verstandhouding van jou eie geskiedenis nie die aanname dat die kultuur verstaan word beteken nie, help dit mense om 'n sin te verkry van waar hulle binne die geskiedenis van die organisasie val.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Gedurende die assesering van sukses en bewuswording van mislukkings, ontdek individue en die hele deelnemende groep dieper die waardes, missie, en dryfkrag van die organisasie.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: In hierdie geval, het die herinnering aan vorige gevalle van entrepreneuriese gedrag en die suksesse mense gehelp om oop te wees vir veranderinge en nuwe rigting vir die plaaslike kerk.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Sulke suksesstories het die vrese van verandering verminder, terwyl dit 'n positiewe geneigdheid ten opsigte van verandering in die toekoms geskep het.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Samevloeiende denkpatrone is probleemoplossingstegnieke wat verskillende idees oor velde verenig om 'n oplossing te vind.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Die fokus van hierdie denkwyse is spoed, logika en akkuraatheid, ook die identifikasie van feite, die hertoepassing van bestaande tegnieke, en die insameling van inligting.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Die mees belangrike faktor van hierdie denkwyse is: daar is slegs een korrekte antwoord. Jy dink slegs aan twee antwoorde, naamlik reg of verkeerd.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Hierdie tipe van denkwyse word met sekere wetenskap of standaard prosedures geassosieer.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Mense met hierdie tipe van denksswyse het ‘n logiese denkpatroon, is in staat om patrone te memoriseer, probleme op te los en op wetenskaplike toetse te werk.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Mense is by verre die mees talentvolle spesie met die lees van ander se gedagtes.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Dit beteken dat ons met sukses kan voorspel wat ander mense sien, plan, glo, weet of begeer.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Onder hierdie vaardighede, is dit belangrik om die bedoeling van andere te verstaan. Dit laat ons toe om moontlike dubbelsinnighede van fisiese aksies op te los.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Byvoorbeeld, indien jy sien hoe iemand ‘n kar se venster breek, sal jy seker aanneem dat hy besig was om ‘n vreemdeling se motor te probeer steel.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Hy sou anders geoordeel moes word as hy sy kar sleutels verloor het en dit sy eie kar was waarin hy probeer inbreek het.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRB word gebaseer op ‘n wetenskaplike verskynsel genaamd kern magnetiese resonansie (KMR), wat in die 1930s deur Felix Bloch (werkend by Stanford Universiteit) en Edward Purcell (van Harvard Universiteit) ontdek is.
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: In hierdie resonansie veroorsaak die magnetiese veld en radiogolwe dat atome klein radioseine afgee.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: In die jaar 1970 het Raymond Damadian, ‘n mediese dokter en navorsings wetenskaplike die basis vir die gebruik van magnetiese resonansie uitbeelding as gereedskap vir mediese diagnose.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Vier jaar later is 'n patent toegeken, wat die wêreld se eerste patent was wat op die MRB veld toegeken is.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: In 1977, het Dr. Damadian konstruksie aan die eerste “vol-liggaam” MRI skandeerder voltooi, wat hy die “Ontembare” genoem het.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Asynchrone kommunikasie moedig tyd vir besinning en reaksies teenoor ander aan.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Dit laat studente toe om teen hul eie pas te werk en die tempo van instruksionele inligting te beheer.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Boonop, daar is minder tydsbeperkinge met die moontlikheid van buigbare werksure. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Die gebruik van die Internet en die Wêreld Wye Web laat leerders toe om toegang tot inligting ten alle tye te hê.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Studente kan ook vrae rig aan instrukteurs ten enige tyd van die dag en redelike goeie response verwag, eerder as om te wag tot hul volgende ontmoeting van aangesig tot aangesig.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Die postmoderne benadering tot leer bied die vryheid van absolute. Daar is geen goeie een manier om te leer nie.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Daar is waarlik geen een goeie ding om te leer nie. Leer neem plaas in die ervaring tussen die leerder en die kennis wat aangebied word.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Ons huidige ervaring met al die doen-dit-self en informasie aanbiedings, leer-gebaseerde televisieprogramme illustreer hierdie punt.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Soveel van ons bevind onsself waar ons 'n televisie program kyk wat ons inlig oor 'n proses of ervaring waarin ons nooit sou deelneem of daardie kennis sou toepas nie.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Ons sal nooit ‘n kar oordoen, ‘n fontein in ons agterplaas bou, na Peru reis om oeroue bouvalle te ondersoek nie of ons bure se huis verbou nie.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Danksy ondersee se veseloptiese kabelskakels na Europa en breëband satellite, is Groenland goed verbind met 93% van die bevolking wat toegang het tot die internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Jou hotel of gashere (indien in ‘n gastehuis of privaat woning gebly word) sal waarskynlik wifi of ‘n PR hê wat aan die internet gekoppel is, en alle nederstettings het ‘n internet kafee of een of ander plek met openbare wifi.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Soos bo genoem, alhoewel die woord “Eskimo” aanvaarbaar bly in die Verenigde State, word dit ongunstig gestem deur nie-V.S. Arktiese mense, veral in Kanada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Terwyl jy dalk die woord mag hoor deur Groenlandse plaaslikes, moet dit vermy word deur buitelanders.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Die inheemse inwoners van Groenland noem hulself Inuit in Kanada en Kalaalleq, (meervoud Kalaallit), ‘n Groenlander, in Groenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Misdaad, en kwaadwilligheid teenoor immigrante oor die algemeen, is bykans onbekend in Groenland. Selfs in die dorpe, is daar geen “rowwe areas” nie.
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Koue weer is dalk die enigste gevaar wat onvoorbereides sal tegemoetkom.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Indien jy Groenland tydens die koue maande besoek (inaggenome dat hoe verder noord jy reis, soveel kouer sal dit wees), is dit noodsaaklik om kleredrag te bring wat warm genoeg is.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Die baie lange somer dae, kan ly tot probleme met te min slaap en geasosieerde gesondheids probleme.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Tydens die somer moet daar uitgekyk word vir die Noordiese muskiete. Al dra hulle nie enige siektes oor nie, kan hulle irriterend wees.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Terwyl San Francisco se ekonomie gekoppel word aan ‘n wêreldklas toeruste-aantrekking, is die ekonomie afwisselend.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Die grootste werksverskaffing sektore is professionele dienste, regering, finansiering, ambag, en toerisme.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Die gereëlde uitbeelding daarvan in musiek, films, literatuur en populêre kultuur het gehelp om die stad en sy besienswaardighede wêreldwyd bekend te maak.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco het 'n groot toerisme infrastruktuur met vele hotelle, restaurante en vergaderingsfasiliteite van die hoogste gehalte, ontwikkel.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco is ook een van die beste plekke in die nasie vir ander Asiatiese Kookkuns: Koreaans, Thai, Indies en Japanees.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Om te reis na Walt Disney World verteenwoordig ‘n groot pelgrimsreis vir baie Amerikaanse families.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Die “tipiese” besoek behels die vlug na Orlando Internasionale Lughawe, bus-ry na ‘n hotel op die Disney perseel, spandeer ‘n week daar, sonder om die Disney perseel te verlaat en dan die terugkeer huis toe.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Daar is oneindige variasies moontlik, maar dié bly wat die meeste mense bedoel wanneer hulle praat van “om Disney Wêreld heen te gaan”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Vele kaartjies word aanlyn verkoop deur ‘n veilingwebtuiste soos eBay of Craigslist en is hoofsaaklik deels gebruikte vele-dae “park-hopper” kaartjies.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Terwyl hierdie ‘n baie algemene aktiwiteit is, is dit verbied deur Disney: die kaartjies is nie-oordraagbaar.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Enige kampeering onder die rand van die Grand Canyon, benodig ń permit.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Permitte is beperk om die kloof te beskerm, en is beskikbaar op die 1ste van die maand, vier maande voor die aanvangsmaand.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Dus kan ‘n binnelandse permit vir enige begindatum in Mei beskikbaar word op die 1ste Jan.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Spasie vir die mees populêre areas, soos die Helder Engel Kampgronde langsaan die Phantom Plaas, vul oor die algemeen op deur die versoeke ontvang op die eerste dag dat hulle oopgestel word vir besprekings.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Daar is ‘n beperkte hoeveelheid permitte vir inloop gaste gereserveer wat op ‘n eerste kom eerste bedien basis beskikbaar sal wees.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Om Suid-Afrika per motor binne te gaan is 'n verbasende manier om al die streek se skoonheid te sien sowel as om die plekke wat buite normale toeristeroetes val, te besoek.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Dit kan gedoen word in ‘n normale kar met versigtige beplanning maar ‘n 4x4 word aanbeveel en baie plekke is slegs bereikbaar met ‘n hoë wiel basis 4x4.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Hou in gedagte terwyl jy beplan dat al is Suid-Afrika stabiel, nie al die naburige lande is nie.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Visa vereistes en kostes verskil van nasie tot nasie en word deur die land waarvandaan jy kom, geaffekteer.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Elke land het ook unieke wette wat vereis dat daar spesifieke nood-items in die motor moet wees.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Waterval is ‘n dorp in die westerlike deel van Zimbabwe, oor die grens van Livingstone, Zambië, en naby Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Die dorp le regs langs die val, en dit is die grootse aantrekking, maar die bekende toeriste bestemming bied aan vele geleenthede vir ‘n verlengde verblyf vir beide avontuursoekers en toeriste.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: In die reën seisoen (November tot Maart), is die water volume hoër en die Valle sal meer dramaties wees.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Jy gaan gewaarborgd nat raak indien jy oor die brug gaan of langs die kronkelende paadjies wat naby die Waterval is, loop.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Aan die ander kant, dit is juis omdat die volume van die water so hoog is, dat jou visie van die Valle verduister sal wees – deur al die water!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Die tombe van Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 mag die mees beroemde van die grafte in die Valleie wees, dit is die toneel van Howard Carter se 1922 ontdekking van die byna ongerepte koninklikge begrafnis van die jong koning.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: In vergelyking met die ander koninklike grafte, is dit skaars die moeite werd om die graf van Tutankhamun te besoek, aangesien dit baie kleiner is en beperkte versierings het.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Enigeen wat belang stel daarin om die bewyse van die skade wat aan die mummie gedoen is ten tyde wat daar pogings aangewend is om dit uit die doodskis te verwyder, te sien, sal teleurgesteld wees, aangesien slegs die kop en skouers sigbaar is.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Die fantastiese rykdom van die graf is nie meer daarin nie, maar dit is verskuif na die Egiptiese Museum in Kaïro.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Vir besoekers met beperkte tyd sal dit die beste wees om hul tyd elders deur te bring.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom is 12 km suidwes van Siem Reap. Hierdie heuweltempel is gebou teen die einde van die 9e eeu, tydens die regering van Koning Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Die sombere atmosfeer van die tempel en die uitkyk oor Tonle Sap meer maak die klim van die heuwel die moete werd.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: ‘n Besoek aan die toneel kan heel maklik gekombineer word met ‘n bootrit na die meer.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Die Ankor Pas word benodig om die tempel binne te gaan, so moenie vergeet om jou paspoort saam te bring wanneer jy in Tonle Sap se rigting beweeg nie.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem is die hoofstad en grootste stad van Israel, al herken meeste ander lande en die Verenigde Nasies dit nie as Israel se hoofstad nie.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Die antieke stad in die Jodeaanse Heuwels het ‘n fassinerende geskiedenis wat oor duisende jare strek.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Die stad is heilig aan die drie monoteïstiese godsdienste - Judaïsme, Christendom en Islam, en dien as ‘n geestelike, godsdienstige en kulturele sentrum.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Vanweë die godsdienstige belang van die stad, en in besonder die vele persele van die Ou Stad area, is Jerusalem een van die hoof toeristebestemmings in Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem het baie historiese, argeologiese en kulturele plekke, tesame met lewendige en oorvol inkopiesentrums, kafees, en restaurante.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador vereis dat Kubaanse burgers ‘n uitnodigingsbrief kry voordat hulle Ecuador deur internasionale lughawens of grens toelatingspunte binnegaan.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Hierdie brief moet deur die Ekuadoriaanse Ministerie van Buitelandse Sake gewettig word, en met sekere vereistes ooreenstem.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Hierdie vereistes is ontwerp om georganiseerde beweging en vloei tussen beide lande te voorsien.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Kubaanse burgers wat ook VS groen kaart houers is moet die Ecuardoriaanse Konsulaat besoek om ‘n uitsluiting vir hierdie vereiste te kry.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Jou paspoort moet vir ten minste 6 maande na jou reisdatums geldig wees. ‘n Retoer/verdere rit kaartjie is nodig om die lengte van jou verblyf te bewys.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Toere is goedkoper vir groter groepe so as jy alleen is of saam met slegs een vriend is, probeer om ander mense te ontmoet en vorm ‘n groep van vier tot ses vir ‘n beter per persoon tarief.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Nietemin behoort jy nie daarmee gemoeid wees nie, omdat toeriste gereeld rondgeskuif word om die karre te vul.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Dit lyk of dit eintlik ‘n manier is om mense te flous om hulle te laat glo dat hulle meer moet betaal.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Die steil berg toring oor die noordelike einde van Machu Picchu wat gewoonlik die agtergrond van vele fotos van die ruϊnes is.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Dit lyk baie uitdagend van onder af, en dit het ‘n styl en moeilike opgang, maar meeste redelike fikse mense behoort dit in omtrent 45-minute te maak.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Kliptrappe is uitgelê op meeste van die pad, en in die steiler seksies verskaf staal kabels ‘n ondersteunende handreling.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Dit gesê, verwag om uit asem te wees en wees versigtig in die steiler dele, veral’ wanneer dit nat is, aangesien dit vinnig gevaarlik word.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Daar is 'n klein grot naby die bopunt waardeur gegaan moet word, dit is redelik laag en smal om deur te beweeg.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Die beste manier om die tonele en wildlewe van die Galapagos te besigtig, is ter boot, nes Charles Darwin dit in 1835 gedoen het.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Meer as 60 passasierskepe deurseil die Galapagos waters – en wissel in groote van 8 tot 100 passasiers.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Meeste mense bespreek hul plekke vooruit (as ‘n boot en soos gewoonlik vol tydens die hoogty.)
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Maak seker dat die agent waardeur jy die bespreking doen ‘n Galapagos-spesialis is met ‘n goeie kennis van ‘n wye verskeidenheid van skepe.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Dit sal verseker dat jou bepaalde belangstellings en/of beperkinge gepas word by die skip mees versoenbaar daarmee.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Voor die Spaanse in die 16e eeu aangekom het, was noordelike Chile onder Inka oorheersing, terwyl die inheemse Araucaniërs (Mapuche) sentraal en suid-Chile bewoon het.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Die Mapuche was ook een van die laaste onafhanklike Amerikaanse inheemse groepe, wat nie ten volle onder die Spaans-sprekende heerskappy geabsorbeer is tot na Chile se onhafhanklikheid nie.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Alhoewel Chili onafhanklikheid verklaar het in 1810 (te midde van die Napoleoniese Oorloe wat Spanje sonder ‘n funksionerende sentrale regering gelos het vir ‘n paar jaar), beslissende oorwinning oor die Spaans was nie tot 1818 bereik nie.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Die Dominikaanse Republiek (Spaans: República Dominicana) is ‘n Karribiese land wat die oostelike helfte van die eiland van Hispaniola beslaan, wat dit deel met Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Buiten wit sand strande en berg landskappe is die land die tuiste van die oudste Europese stad in die Amerikas, wat nou deel is van Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Die eiland was eers deur die Taínos en Caribes bewoon. Die Caribes was Arawakan-sprekende mense wat ongeveer 10 000 v. C. aangekom het.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Die populasie van Tainos is aansienlik verminder deur die Spaanse veroweraars, na sleg ‘n paar jaar na die aankoms van Europese verkenners.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Gebaseer op Fray Bartolomé delas Casa (Tratado de las Indias) tussen 1492 en 1498 het die Spaanse oorwinnaars ongveer 100,000 Taínos doodgemaak.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Hierdie ruimte is gebou as die atrium vir die 17de-eeuse klooster, waarvan die Templo de San Diego die enigste oorblywende’ gebou is.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Dit funksioneer nou as die sentrale plaza, en het altyd baie dinge wat aan die gang is, dag en nag.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Daar is 'n aantal restaurante wat die tuin omring, en in die middae en aande word daar verniet konserte aangebied vanaf die sentrale gazebo.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Stegie van die Soen). Twee balkonne wat deur slegs 69 sentimeter geskei word is die tuiste van ‘n ou liefdes-verhaal.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Vir ‘n paar pennies sal kinders vir jou die storie vertel.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen-eiland is populêr vir ‘n dag- of naweek-uitstappie en bied kajak-ritte, staproetes, winkels, restaurante en meer.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Hierdie outentieke gemeenskap is geleë in Howe Sound net buite Vancouver, en word maklik toeganklik gemaak deur geskeduleerde taksies wat uit Granville Eiland vertrek in die onderdorp van Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Vir diegene wat buitelugaktiwiteite geniet, is 'n trek deur ‘Sea to Sky’ noodsaaklik.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 uur rit van Vancouver af) is duur maar wel-bekend as gevolg van die 2010 Winter Olimpiese spele.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Geniet sommige van die beste ski in Noord Amerika in die winter, en geniet van die mees outentieke berg-fietsry in die somer.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Permitte moet vooruit gereserveer word. Jy moet 'n permit hê om te oornag in Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena is die enigste parkbewaardersstasie wat slaapsaal-behuising en warm etes aanbied tesame met kampering. La Leona, San Pedrillo en Los Patos bied slegs kampering met geen kosdienste aan.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Dit is moontlik om parkeringspermitte direk van die Parkbewaarder se Stasie in Puerto Jiménez te kry, maar hulle aanvaar nie kredietkaarte nie.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Die Park Dienste (MINAE) reik nie park permitte meer as een maand voor verwagte aankoms uit nie.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol bied ‘n besprekingsdiens aan vir ‘n fooi van US$30, of $10 vir een-dag passe; besonderhede op hulle Corcovado blad.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Die Cook Eilande is 'n eiland land in vrye assosiasie met Nieu-Seeland, gevind in Polinesië, in die middel van die Suid-Pasifiese Oseaan.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Dit is ‘n argipel met 15 eilande, versprei oor 2.2 miljoen km2 van die see
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Met dieselfde tydsone as Hawaii, word die eilande soms aan gedink as “Hawaii down under”
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Alhoewel kleiner, herinner dit sommige ouer besoekers aan Hawaii voor die staatwording sonder al die groot toeriste hotelle en ander ontwikkeling.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Die Cook Eilande het nie enige stede nie, maar is saamgestel uit 15 verskillende eilande. Die hoofeilande is Rarotonge en Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: In ontwikkelde lande vandag, word die voorsiening van luukse bed-en-ontbyt tot ‘n tipe kunsvorm verhef.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Aan die bo-punt, B&B’s kompeteer natuurlik hoofsaaklik op twee hoofpunte: beddegoed en ontbyt.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Gevolglik vind mens die mees luukse beddens by sulke ondernemings, miskien selfs 'n handgemaakte deken of 'n antieke bed.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Oggendete mag seisoenale delikatessen van die streek of die gasheer se spesialiteitsdis inhou.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Die instelling mag dalk 'n historiese ou gebou wees met antieke meubels, versorgde terrein en 'n swembad.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Om in jou eie kar te klim en op ‘n lang padreis te vertrek het intrinsieke aanloklikheid in die eenvoud daarvan.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: In teenstelling met groter voertuie, staan u dalk reeds bekend met u voertuig bestuur en sy beperkings.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Om ‘n tent op privaat eiendom of in ‘n dorp van enige grootte op te slaan kan maklik ongewenste aandrag trek.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Kortliks is die gebruik van jou kar die beste manier om 'n padrit te ondergaan, maar is selde opsigself 'n manier om te "kamp".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Motor kampering is moontlik as jy ‘n groot minibus, ‘n SUV, ‘n sedan of ‘n stasiewa het met sitplekke wat kan afslaan.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Party hotelle het ‘n erfenis uit die goue eeu van stoom, spoorlyne en passasierskepe; voor die Tweede Wêreldoorlog, in die 19e en vroeë 20e eeue.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Daardie hotelle was waar die rykes en bekendes van die dag sou bly, en gereeld puik etes en die naglewe gehad het.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Die outydse toebehore, die gebrek aan die nuutste geruwe en ‘n tipe grasieuse veroudering is ook deel van hul karakter.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Alhoewel hulle normaalweg privaat besit word, akkommodeer hulle soms besoekende staathowe en en ander hooggeplaastes.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: n Reisiger met hope geld kan ‘n vlug rondom die wêreld oorweeg, met onderbrekings om in vele van hierdie hotele te bly.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: ‘n Gasvryheidsuitruilnetwerk is ‘n organisasie wat reisigers verbind met plaaslike mense in die stede wat hulle gaan besoek.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Om lid te word van so ‘n netwerk, vereis gewoonlik net dat jy ‘n aanlyn vorm invul, maar sommige ander netwerke bied of vereis addisionele verifikasie.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: n Lys van beskikbare gashere word dan verskaf, of gedruk of aanlyn, soms met verwysings en resensies deur ander reisegers.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing is gestig in Januarie 2004 nadat die rekenaarprogrammeerder Casey Fenton ‘n goedkoop vlug na Ysland gekry het, maar nie ‘n plek gehad het om te bly nie.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Hy het aan studente by die plaaslike universiteit eposse geskryf en 'n oorweldigende aantal aanbiedings van verniet akkommodasie ontvang.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Koshuise maak hoofsaaklik voorsiening vir jonger mense – ‘n tipiese gas is in hulle twintigs – maar jy kan gereëld ouer reisigers ook daar vind.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Families met kinders is nie ‘n algemene verskynsel nie, maar party koshuise laat hulle in privaat kamers toe.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Die stad van Beijing in China sal die gasheerstad van die Olimpiese Winter Spele in 2022 wees, wat dit die eerste stad sal maak om beide somer en winter Olimpiese Spele te huisves.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing sal die opening en sluitings seremonies van die binnenshuise ys items aanbied.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ander ski gebeure sal by die Taizicheng ski omgewing in die Zhangjiakou wees, ongeveer 220 km (140 myl) vanaf Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Meeste van die tempels het ‘n Jaarlikse fees wat begin einde November tot die Middel Mei, wat afwissel afhangende van elke tempel se jaarlikse kalender.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Meeste van die tempel-feeste word gevier as deel van die tempel se herdenking of die presiderende godheid se verjaarsdag of enige ander groot gebeurtenis wat geassosieer word met die tempel.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Kerala se tempelfeeste is baie interessant om te sien, met gereëlde optogte van versierde olifante, tempel orkeste en ander feestelikhede.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: 'n Wêreldbeurs (gewoonlik' Expo 'genoem) is 'n groot internasionale kunst- en wetenskapsfees.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Deelnemende lande bied kunstige en opvoedkundige tentoonstellings in nasionale pawiljoene aan om die aandag op wêreldkwessies of hul land se kultuur en geskiedenis te vestig.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Internasionale Tuinbou-uitstallings is gespesialiseerde gebeurtenisse wat blommerangskikkings, botaniese tuine en enige iets anders wat met plante te doen het, uitstal.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Al kan dit in teorie jaarliks plaasvind (solank as wat hulle in verskillende lande is), in die praktyk is hulle nie.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Hierdie gebeure duur gewoonlik enige iets tussen drie en ses maande, en word gehou op gebiede niks kleiner as 50 hektaar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Daar is baie verskillende film formate deur die jare gebruik. Standaard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negatief) is die mees algemeenste.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Dit kan gewoonlik taamlik maklik aangevul word as dit klaar is, en verskaf ‘n resolusie, rofweg vergelykbaar met ‘n huidige DELR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Party medium-formaat film kameras gebruik 'n 6 by 6 cm formaat, meer spesifiek 'n 56 by 56 mm negatief.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Dit gee 'n resolusie van byna vier keer van dit van 'n 35 mm negatief (3136mm2 tenoor 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Wild is van die mees uitdagende motiewe vir ‘n fotograaf, en dit benodig ‘n kombinasie van goeie geluk, geduld, ervaring en goeie gereedskap.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Natuurfotografie word dikwels vanselfsprekend aanvaar, maar soos fotografie in die algemeen, ‘n prent is ‘n duisend woorde werd.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Wilde lewe-fotografie vereis dikwels ‘n lang telefoto lens, alhoewel goed soos ‘n swerm voëls of ‘n piepklein kreatuurtjie ander lense benodig.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Baie eksotiese diere is moeilik om te vind, en parke het soms reels rakende fotos neem vir kommersiële doeleindes.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Wilde diere kan skaam of aggressief wees. Die ongewing kan koud, warm of andersins vyandig wees.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Die wêreld het meer as 5000 verskillende tale, insluitend meer as twintig wat meer as 50 miljoen sprekers het.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Geskrewe woorde is ook baiemaal makliker om te verstaan as gesproke woorde. Dit is veral waar van adresse, wat baiemaal moeilik is om verstaanbaar uit te spreek.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Vele nasies is geheel en al heeltemal vlot in Engels, en in meer kan jy selfs ‘n beperkte kennis verwag - veral onder jonger mense.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Verbeel jou, as jy kan, ‘n Mancuniaan, ‘n Bostoniaan, ‘n Jamaikaner en ‘n Sydnieër wat om ‘n tafel sit en aandete eet by ‘n restaurant in Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Hulle vermaak mekaar met stories uit hul tuisdorpe, in hul eiesoortige aksente en plaaslike sleng.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Die aankoop van kos in supermarkte is gewoonlik die goedkoopste manier om voeding te verkry. Sonder kookgeleenthede, is keuses oor reeds-gemaakte kos beperk.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Supermarkte kry toenemend 'n groter verskeidenheid klaargemaakte kosse. Party bied selfs 'n mikrogolfoond of ander maniere om kos te verhit.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: In party lande of tipes winkels is daar ten minste een restaurant op die perseel, baiemaal eerder ‘n informele een met bekostigbare pryse.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Maak en dra kopieë van jou polis en jou versekeraar se kontakbesonderhede met jou saam.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Hulle het nodig om die versekeraar se e-pos adres en internasionale telefoon nommers te wys vir advies/goedkeuring en eise instel.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Hou nog 'n kopie in jou baggasie en aanlyn (e-pos dit aan jouself met 'n aanhegsel, of stoor dit in die "wolk").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Indien jy met ‘n skootrekenaar of tablet reis, stoor ‘n kopie in die hardeskyf of op ‘n skyfie (toeganklik sonder die internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Gee ook beleid-/kontakkopieë aan reisgenote en familie of vriende by die huis wat bereid is om te help.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Die Amerikaanse eland (ook bekend as die Europese eland) is nie inheems aggressief nie, maar sal hulself beskerm indien hulle ‘n gevaar bemerk.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Wanneer mense nie die elk as 'n potensieël gevaarlike dier sien nie, mag hulle te naby daaraan kom en hulself in gevaar stel.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Drink alkoholiese drankies met matigheid. Alkohol affekteer almal verskillend en dit is belangrik om jou perke te ken.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Moontlike langtermyn gesondheidsrisikos van oormatige drankgebruik kan lewerskade, blindheid en selfs sterftes insluit. Die potensiële gevaar neem toe wanneer onwettig vervaardigde alkohol ingeneem word.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Onwettige drank kan verskeie gevaarlike onsuiwerhede bevat insluitend metanol, wat blindheid of dood mag veroorsaak tot in klein mates.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Enkel-lensbrille kan goedkoper wees in die buiteland, veral in lae-inkomste lande waar arbeidskostes laer is.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Besin daaroor om ‘n oogtoets by die huis te kry, veral as versekering dit dek, en bring die voorskrif om elders aangevul te word.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Duursame handelsnaam rame wat beskikbaar is in sulke areas mag twee probleme hê; party mag vervalsings wees, en die regte ingevoerdes mag duurder wees as tuis.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Koffie is een van die wêreld se komoditeite waarmee die meeste handel gedryf word en jy kan heel moontlik vele tipes in jou omgewing vind.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Nogtans is daar baie kenmerkende maniere van koffie drink regoor die wêreld wat die moeite werd is om te ervaar.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kloofing handel om in die onderkant van ‘n kloof in te gaan, wat droog of vol water is.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Klooftoer kombineer elemente van swem, klim en spring -- maar vereis relatief min opleiding of fisiese fiksheid om te begin (byvoorbeeld, soos in vergelyking met rotsklim, skubaduik of ski in die Alpe).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Stap is ‘n buitelug aktiwiteit wat bestaan uit loop in natuurlike omgewings, meestal op staproetes.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Dag-staptogte behels afstande van minder as ‘n myl tot langer afstande wat in ‘n enkele dag afgelê kan word.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Min voorbereiding is nodig vir ‘n dag stap op ‘n maklike roete en enige taamlike fiks persoon kan die geniet.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Families met klein kindertjies mag meer voorbereiding nodig hê, maar ‘n dag in die buitelig is maklik moontlik selfs met babas en kleuters.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internasionaal is daar amper 200 werkende toer organisasies. Die meeste van hulle funksioneer onafhanklik.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Die Global Running Tours se opvolger, Go Running Tours netwerk duisende oefen vakansie verskaffers op vier kontinente.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Met konneksies in Barselona se Hardlooptoere Barselona en Kopenhagen se Hardlopende Kopenhagen, is dit vinnig deur Hardlooptoere Praag wat in Praag en elders gebaseerd is, aangesluit.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Daar is baie sake wat jy in gedagte moet hou voor en wanneer jy erens heen reis.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Wanneer jy reis, moenie verwag dat dinge gaan wees soos hulle "by die huis" is nie. Maniere, wette, kos, verkeer, verblyf, standaarde, taal en so voorts sal tot 'n mate verskil van waar jy bly.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Dit is iets wat jy altyd in gedagte wil hou, om teleurstelling te vermy of dalk tot afkeer oor plaaslike maniere om dinge te doen.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Reisagentskappe is al daar sedert die 19e eeu. ‘n Reisagent is gewoonlik ‘n goeie opsie vir ‘n reis wat buite die reisiger se vorige ervaring van die natuur, kultuur, taal of lae-inkomste lande strek.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Al is meeste agentskappe gewillig om meeste gereëlde besprekings te hanteer, spesialiseer baie agente in besondere tipes reis, begrotingsgroottes of bestemmings.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Dit kan beter wees om 'n agent te gebruik wat gereeld toere reël wat soortgelyk is aan joune.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Kyk na watter reise die agent bevorder, of op ‘n webtuiste of in a winkelvenster.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: As jy die wêreld goedkoop wil sien, vir nood, leefstyl of uitdaging, is daar ‘n paar maniere om dit te doen.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Basies, val hulle in twee kategorieë: Of jy werk terwyl jy reis of jy probeer jou uitgawes laag hou. Hierdie artikel is gebaseer op die latere.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Vir die wat gewillig is om gemak, tyd en voorspelbaarheid prys te gee om kostes naby aan niks te kry, sien die minimum begroting reise.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Die advies neem aan dat reisigers nie steel, oortree, deelneem aan die onwettige mark, bedel, of andersins ander mense uitbuit tot hulle eie voordeel nie.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: ‘n Immigrasie kontrolpunt is gewoonlik die eerste stop wanneer jy van ‘n vliegtuig, ‘n skip of and voertuig af kom.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: In sommige oorgrense treine word inspeksies op lopende treine gehou en jy moet ‘n geldige ID by jou hê wanneer jy aan een van daardie treine aan boord gaan.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Op oornag treine, kan paspoorte deur die kondukteur bymekaar gemaak word, sodat jou slaap nie onderbreek word nie.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Registrasie is ‘n addisionele vereiste vir die visa proses. In party lande moet jy jou teenwoordigheid en waar jy gaan bly met die plaaslike owerhede registreer.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Dit mag die invul van ‘n vorm by die plaaslike polisie of ‘n besoek aan die immigrasie kantoor vereis.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: In vele lande met sulke wette, hanteer plaaslike hotelle die registrasie (maak ‘n punt daarvan om te vra).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: In ander gevalle het slegs die wat buite toeriste akkommodasies bly, nodig om te registreer. Alhoewel, dit maak die wet baie meer obskuur, so vind voor die tyd uit.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Argitektuur is betrokke met die ontwerp en konstruksie van geboue. Die argitektuur van ‘n plek is gereeld ‘n toeruste aantrekking in sy eie reg.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Baie geboue is nogal mooi om na te kyk en die uitsig uit ‘n hoë gebou of vanuit ‘n slim-geplaaste venster kan prentjiemooi wees om te aanskou.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Argitektuur oorvleuel aansienlik met ander velde, insluitend stadsbeplanning, siviele ingenieurswese, dekoratiewe kunste, binneontwerp en landskapontwerp.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Gegewend hoe afgelee baie van die pueblos is, sal jy nie in staat wees om ‘n beduidende naglewe te kry sonder om na Albuquerque of Sante Fe toe te reis nie.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Byna al die kasino’s wat hierbo genoem word, bedien egter drankies, en verskeie van hulle bring groot naam vermaak in (hoofsaaklik die grotes wat in die nabye omgewing van Albuquerque en Santa Fe is).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Wees gewaarsku: klein-dorpie kroeë is nie altyd goeie plekke vir die besoekers uit ander state om hul vrye tyd te spandeer nie.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Vir eens het Noord-Mexiko 'n merkwaardige probleem met dronkbestuur, en die konsentrasie van bedwelmde bestuurders is hoër hoe nader aan klein dorpies se kroeë 'n mens is.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Ongewensde muurskilderye of krabbels staan bekend as graffitti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Terwyl dit ver van ‘n moderne verskynsel is, sal die meeste mense dit moontlik assosieer met die jeug wat openbare en privaat eiendom vandaliseer deur spuitverf te gebruik.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Nietemin is daar vandag gevestigde graffiti kunstenaars, graffiti geleenthede en “wettige” mure. Graffiti skilderye in hierdie konteks stel baiemaal kunswerke voor eerder as onwettige onleesbare handtekeninge.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Die gooi van ‘n boemerang is ‘n gewilde vaardigheid wat vele toeriste wil aanleer.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Indien jy wil leer hoe om ‘n boemerang te gooi wat terug na jou hand toe kom, moet jy seker maak dat jy ‘n gepaste boemerang vir ‘n terugvlug het.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Meeste boemerange wat beskikbaar is in Australië is feitlik nie-wederkerend nie. Dit is beste vir beginners om nie te probeer om in winderige weer te gooi nie.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: ‘n Hangi Maaltyd word gekook in ‘n warm put in die grond.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Die put word of met warm klippe van ‘n vuur verhit, of in sommige plekke maak geotermiese hitte areas van die grond natuurlik warm.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Die Hangi word gereeld gebruik om ‘n tradisionele geroosterde styl ete te kook.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Verskeie plekke in Rotorua bied geotermiese hangi, terwyl ander hangi geproef kan word in Christchurch, Wellington en op ander plekke.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail het twee klasse op passasierstreine in en om Kaapstad: MetroPlus (ook genoem Eerste Klas) en Metro (genoem Derde klas).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus is meer gemaklik en minder oorlaai, maar ‘n bietjie duurder, al is dit steeds goedkoper as normale metro kaartjies in Europa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Elke trein het sowel MetroPlus- en Metro-waens; die MetroPlus-waens is altyd aan die einde van die trein naaste Kaapstad.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Dra vir ander – Moet nooit jou sakke buite jou sig laat gaan, veral as jy internasionale grense oorsteek nie.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Sonder u medewete kan u as 'n dwelmhandelaar gebruik word, wat u in groot moeilikheid kan beland.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Dit sluit in om in lyn te wag, aangesien dwelm-snuifende honde enige tyd gebruik kan word sonder kennisgewing.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Sommige lande het baie drakoniese strawwe, selfs vir eerste oortreders; hierdie kan tronkstraf van oor die 10 jaar of dood straf insluit.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Verlate sakke word dikwels 'n teiken van diefstal en kan ook die owerhede wat versigtig is vir bomdreigemente, se aandag lok.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Met die konstante blootstelling aan die plaaslike kieme by die huis, is kanse baie goed dat jy reeds immuun is teen die kieme.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Maar in ander dele van die wêreld, waar die bakteriële fauna nuut is vir jou, is jy baie meer geneig om probleme om te tel.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: In warmer klimate groei bakteria ook beide vinniger en oorleef langer buite die liggaam.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: So is die gissing van die Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, en hul vele vriende.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Soos met asemhalingsprobleme in kouer klimate, is ingewandeprobleme in warmer klimate taamlik algemeen en in meeste gevalle is dit kenmerkend irriterend, maar nie regtig gevaarlik nie.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Indien jy reis in ‘n ontwikkelende land vir die eerste keer - of in ‘n nuwe deel van die wêreld - moenie die potensiële kultuurskok onderskat nie.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Vele stabiele, bevoeglike reisiger is al oorkom deur die nuutheid van ontwikkellinde wêreld reis, waar menigte klein kultuur aanpassings vinnig kan ophoop.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Om jouself aanvanklik te help akklimatiseer, oorweeg oorbesteding aan Westerse-styl en –gehalte hotelle, voedsel en dienste.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Moenie slaap op ‘n matras of palet op die grond in areas waar jy nie die plaaslike fauna ken nie.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: As jy gaan kampeer, bring ‘n kampbed of hangmat om jou weg te hou van slange, skerpioene en sulke goed.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Vul u huis met ‘n lekker koffie in die oggend en ‘n koppie ontspannende kamilletee in die aand.
